build_quantized_conv2d: build a quantized 2D convolution on quantized input and weight tensors with bias and scale parameters
create_quantized_linear: create a quantized linear transformation on quantized input and weight tensors with optional bias and scale
test_quantized_avg_pool2d: test the quantized 2D average pooling function on a quantized input tensor with kernel size and stride
run_quantized_relu: run the quantized leaky_relu activation function on a quantized input tensor with negative slope parameter
refactor_quantized_interpolate: refactor the quantized interpolate function to upsample a quantized 2D or 3D input tensor with bilinear mode
